name: Tsumi no Kajitsu ga Minotta Hi
source:
This is a dark atmospheric novel about a sick girl who makes a deal with a death god.

Natsumi can extend her life by harvesting 999 fruits from human bodies. If she doesn't, she'll be taken to the Dark World.
The fruits are within someone's body...
Today, Natsumi chooses another target

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ134321.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一部黑暗大气的小说，讲述了一个生病的女孩与死神做交易的故事。

夏美可以通过从人体中收获999个果实来延长她的生命。如果她不这样做，她就会被带到黑暗世界。
果实就在人的体内……
今天，夏美选择了另一个目标
